svg.title: Nhat Nguyet command line
svg.desc: Terminal recording: "npx @nhatnguyet/cli lunar 1985-01-21 --country CN" prints the Chinese lunar date (1984-12-01, still the 12th month while Vietnam celebrates Tết), then "npx @nhatnguyet/cli ziwei 1990-09-19 20:00 male" prints a Zi Wei Dou Shu chart as a 4x4 grid.
svg.text: │ Ji Mao │ Na yin: Earth by the Roadside │ Bing Xu Xun Kong │

text.tspan: Brightness: Ex exalted, Pr prosperous, Fa favorable, Ne neutral, We weak. Ages are East
